'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female{{verify}} [[NPC]] found inside the Rabelle College building, hiding inside a cardboard box. She's incredibly shy and wishes to make friends. She is only available during the day.

Talking through her dialogues unlocks the ''[[World in All Its Variety II]]'' [[trophy]], ''[[Knock Knock]]''.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Strange Cardboard Box''' (Whispering) Hi nice to meet you I'm Ignatius I'm from the New Federation. 
:;'''Strange Cardboard Box''' I like Voidmatters Science would you like to be friends I could treat you to eat some s-s-s-s-s-saaalad!
:;'''Strange Cardboard Box''' (Whispering) Aaargh I forgot my lines again I can't even introduce myself I'll never have any friends!

==Dialogue==
:'''Person in the Box:''' (Whispering) Hi nice to meet you I'm Ignatius I'm from the New Federation I like Voidmatters Science would you like to be friends I could treat you to eat some s-s-s-s-s-saaalad!
:{{DIcon}} (Knock lightly on the side of the cardboard box.)
:'''Person in the Box:''' …!

:{{DIcon}} (Knock lightly on the top of the cardboard box.)
:'''Person in the Box:'''  … …!!
:{{DIcon}} Nice to meet you! I'm {{Rover}}!
:{{DIcon|Exit}} (Knock forcefully on the cardboard box.)
::'''Person in the Box:''' ...?!"
::{{DIcon}} (Pound on the cardboard box from all sides.)
::'''Person in the Box:''' P-p-p-please don't hit my box.
::{{DIcon}} Nice to meet you! I'm {{Rover}}!
::{{DIcon}} (Loudly) Hi, I’m {{Rover}}!
::{{DIcon}} Just an ordinary student.
:'''Ignatius:''' (Whispering) Hi nice to meet you I'm Ignatius I'm from the New Federation I like Voidmatters Science would you like to be friends I could treat you to eat some s-s-s-s-s-saaalad!
:{{DIcon}} Talk about a mouthful...
:{{DIcon}} What are you stammering on about?
:'''Ignatius:''' (Whispering) I get so nervous around people I literally can't talk. I've been enrolled for ages but I just lurk in the shadows and try to be invisible besides nobody notices me even if I hide in a trash can.
:'''Ignatius:''' (Whispering) I thought if I could just manage to introduce myself then I'd finally be able to make friends that's why I've been practicing in here I wanted to try to talk to people during the celebration but I failed again.
:'''Ignatius:''' (Whispering) I-I-I think I need more practice in here and I was here first so could you please leave me alone for a while of course if you don't want to I can find another place no problem!
:{{DIcon}} Alright, I'll leave you be.
:{{DIcon}} When you practice, try speaking a bit slower and louder.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go get a salad together sometime.
:'''Ignatius:''' (Loudly) Thanks I'll try!
----
:{{DIcon}} (Knock once.)
:'''Ignatius:''' (Whispering) Is that you, {{Rover}}}?
:'''Ignatius:''' (Whispering) I-I'm still not ready. I need more time!
----
;Night time
:{{DIcon}} (Knock once.)
:'''Narration:''' The box sways a bit, but there's nobody inside.

==Related Dialogue Near-by==
;Only available during the {{Quest|Gold Suspended in Shadows}}
:'''Kato:''' There's no sound. You're just hearing things.
:'''Spencer:''' Impossible! I heard it! It was this long hissing sound, like "s-s-s-s-s-s"! But there's [[Ignatius|nobody there]]!
:'''Spencer:''' It must be one of those campus urban legends! "Slain for a Late Submission," maybe?
:'''Kato:''' You're just paranoid cuz you didn't turn in your paper. Maybe... post on the forum? Someone might actually know what's going on.
{{Dialogue End}}
